summary_text: In January 2026, the user purchased fresh vegetables across four independent dates (2026-01-23, 2026-01-28, 2026-01-30, 2026-01-31). Baby Potato (280–320 g) appeared on all four dates, establishing a stable preference with high confidence. Onion (400–450 g) appeared on two dates (2026-01-28, 2026-01-31), establishing a stable preference with at least medium confidence. Coriander Leaves appeared on two dates (2026-01-23, 2026-01-31), establishing a stable preference with at least medium confidence. Other items (Organic Green Chilli, Cleaned Coriander Leaves, Red Carrot, Onion - Sambhar, Spinach Leaves, Broad Beans) appeared only once and are excluded from stable preference claims. Daypart patterns show activity in the morning (above population baseline) and evening (comparable to morning baseline).
